images.screen: A · 접붙이기 — 한우진의 꿈에 가짜 기억을 끼워 넣는 순간
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. A narrative-detective psychological-horror game screen, 16:9, straight-on 2D composition. A dark underwater dream void of deep teal and ink blue, soft god-rays and caustic light from above, drifting motes, film grain and heavy vignette. Across the middle runs a thin glowing cyan lifeline with age ticks; sixteen small sepia silver-gelatin photographs float above and below it (a leaking roof, a schoolyard, a pier crane, a hospital corridor), tethered to the line by faint dashed bioluminescent threads. Unknown memories are blurred and grey behind fog with small cyan tags. A glowing amber seed marks where a fake memory is being inserted inside a narrow amber time-window band; a golden dashed thread links it to its anchor photo, while a jagged trembling crimson thread shoots to a nearby photo that shakes with a red glow, labeled with a tremor number. Bottom console: a still-wet warm amber photograph held in hand, dials for day, place, mood and intensity, a big red tremor readout over a budget gauge. Korean UI text: "접붙인 기억", "떨림 1,800", "끼워 넣기". Elegant serif typography, cinematic, melancholic.

images.screen: B · 자기 훑기 — 같은 규칙을 시술자 자신의 기억망에 돌리는 마지막 밤
images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. The final scene of a psychological-horror memory game, 16:9, flat front-on layout, bleached and overexposed like a faded photograph: warm paper-white fog, soft peach and pale teal light leaks, fine grain, gentle vignette. A thin charcoal line crosses the screen with eleven washed-out grey photo prints evenly spaced along it (a narrow alley with a street lamp, a dormitory window grid with one lit window, a clinic chair under a surgical lamp), joined above by thin arcing threads. Three of the prints tremble, outlined in deep crimson with hairline red cracks across the image, and their arcs turn jagged red. Below, a minimal bar chart of residual tremor: grey bars under a dashed red threshold line, three tall crimson bars breaking through it. A faint vertical red scan beam sweeps across. Bottom panel: two empty dashed selection slots and a calm quiet control chart. Large Korean serif headline "셋이 떤다. 심어진 것은 둘이다.", small labels "문턱 1,000", "뽑아낼 기억". Quiet, clinical, unsettling.
